title: Show the next oil-change interval on recommendations after a completed log
objective: When a synthetic vehicle has an oil change logged at 80,000 km, the recommendations surface must show the next due interval at 90,000 km as scheduled, not hide it.
acceptanceCriteria: Oil log at 80,000 km yields a scheduled card for 90,000 km
A resolved overlay on the previous interval does not hide the next interval
